scope.rationale: Adds persisted admission modes, a one-way conversion state machine, remote pause, redemption draining, chat/EventSub separation, reward selection, free manual adds, and documentation.

integration.rationale: Crosses Twurple OAuth, Helix ownership/read/write operations, redemption EventSub, reconciliation, queue repository, outbox and local HTTP projections; dashboard-reward behavior needs authorized verification.

infrastructure.rationale: No new service, but PostgreSQL migration/checks must represent conversion intent, remote pause confirmation, historical reward identity, and race-safe redemption drain.

knowledge.rationale: Official monetization and Helix docs diverge; OAuth scope acceptance, app ownership, full lifecycle for Dashboard rewards and live chat behavior are not proven in this installation.

risk.rationale: A silent fallback or unmanaged Dashboard redemption could lose queue events or violate point refund/fulfillment guarantees; preserve explicit unknown states and no financial claims.

flags: Live Twitch capability acceptance required before enabling Dashboard reward mode
Implementation authorized and in progress on 2026-10-07
